opening.argument: The video walks viewers through finding Red Packet in the app’s services and entering codes in the Receive section. It presents these steps as a way to seek cryptocurrency rewards, while expressly saying the outcome depends on luck. That qualification matters: the walkthrough describes a promotion, not a guaranteed payout. The speaker also asks viewers to subscribe and press the bell, ordinary channel engagement alongside the instructions. Nothing in the described material requests payment or private credentials, and no loss is observed. The supported reading is an instructional and promotional walkthrough of a rewards feature, with uncertain results, rather than a scheme shown to take viewers’ money or credentials.
